title: 第693章 胡布里斯树第692章 保护铁驭
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 大熊挣扎着起身，伸手摸到了唐的鞋子。
“熊霸天下号……”话还没说完，大熊便晕了过去。
“嘿，大熊，醒醒……彻底昏过去了，虚弱状态。”唐尝试将昏迷的大熊唤醒，但这并没有什么作用。
唐抬起头，与同伴们看向四周，护灵傀儡的驾驶舱陆续掉落。
“魔力不足，触发了机甲的保护限制。”多格做出解释。
“也就是说，他们全都是因为魔力不足昏迷过去的吧？”伊芙娜发出询问，可心底却已有答案，脸色也极难看。
战况越来越差了。
小队几人将目光放向大战场方向，圣骑士们已经疲劳，教会成员的魔力也已匮乏，精灵们更是一个接一个地倒下。
核心战场上，最为活跃的还是那数量少得可怜的惩戒骑士。
“我们得回去支援。”
唐立刻带着小队重返战场，主要攻击目标便是那两只超巨大的虫王。
伊芙娜留在后方，喝药剂补充魔力。其他人没有坐骑，全程跑回战场，很快吸引了人蚁们的关注。
比起那些如同怪物一样的惩戒骑士，他们对唐小队的仇恨值更高，马上调整攻击目标，集大军向唐小队冲锋。
唐一马当先，冲锋在前。走过的地面不断破开地洞，金克斯化作细剑，在唐手中唤出无尽的剑光。
“剑雨！”
魔力化作细剑落下，遍地人蚁一击致命。
无数身形极为消瘦的飞行人蚁扑向唐。唐在极速的位移中左右挪移，剑光所至，虫群尽灭。
一些飞行较慢的蚂蚁兵种被唐当做踏板，踩在空中，迅速靠近王虫战舰。
下方的多格和辛西娅躲闪着地陷，迅速冲锋，将沿途的人蚁全部掀翻击倒。
唐的目光锁定王虫战舰，忽然剧烈一颤，大喊道：“妮蔻！传讯兵就拜托你了！”
说话间，一颗宝石飞出，是唐携带在身上的回家水晶。
“收到喵！”
光芒闪烁，妮蔻出现半空，全身蓝光绽放，妮蔻在空中扭转身形变成一只鹰隼，穿过飞行人蚁群，直扑王虫战舰。
飞行人蚁见状持长枪冲来，似要堵截妮蔻。唐算准距离，剑指敌将。
“决斗！”
风暴于空中扩散，双方在空中消失，妮蔻成功穿过阻碍，登临王虫战舰上方。
身形扭转，妮蔻在高空恢复身形，甩出带着丝线的匕首，迅速对王虫战舰上的传讯兵完成斩首。
大量人蚁在这瞬间失了方向，行动错乱，多格抓住机会，大刀附着强雷挥砍，劈出一条雷霆大道。
空间再破开，虫将碎片洒落，决斗获胜的唐呈抛物线滑下。
“唐！”辛西娅大喊着，将盾牌丢到唐的脚下，转身迅捷斩，斩杀近身的人蚁。
唐稳稳踩着盾牌，借力蹬出，飞向王虫战舰方向。
金属吞噬者金克斯再度变形化作巨剑，附着赤焰狮牙的火光与唐于此前一直没使用的心焰之力，一剑挥出。
“破空寒冰砍！”
魔力在挥砍途中迅速膨胀，变得比王虫战舰还要巨大。
content_en:
Daxiong struggled to get up and reached out to touch Tang's shoes.
"Xiong Ba Tianxia Hao..." Before he could finish his words, Big Bear fainted.
"Hey, Big Bear, wake up... completely passed out, weak." Tang tried to wake up the unconscious Big Bear, but it had no effect.
Tang raised his head and looked around with his companions. The cockpits of the spirit guardian puppets fell one after another.
"Insufficient magic power triggered the protection restrictions of the mecha." Doge explained.
"In other words, they all fainted due to lack of magic power, right?" Ivona asked, but she already had the answer in her heart, and her face was extremely ugly.
The war situation is getting worse and worse.
The team set their sights in the direction of the big battlefield. The paladins were tired, the church members were running out of magic power, and the elves were falling one after another.
On the core battlefield, the most active ones were the pitifully small number of disciplinary knights.
"We have to go back and provide support."
Tang immediately led his team back to the battlefield, and the main targets of attack were the two giant insect kings.
Yvonne stayed behind, drinking potion to replenish her magic power. The others had no mounts and ran all the way back to the battlefield, quickly attracting the attention of the human ants.
Compared with those monster-like Punishment Knights, they had a higher hatred towards Team Tang. They immediately adjusted their attack targets and gathered their troops to charge towards Team Tang.
Tang Yima took the lead and charged forward. The ground he walked through continued to open holes, and Jinx turned into a thin sword, summoning endless sword light in Tang's hand.
"Sword Rain!"
The magic power turned into a thin sword and fell, killing the ants all over the place with one blow.
Countless extremely thin flying human ants rushed towards Tang. Tang moved left and right at extremely high speeds. Wherever the sword light reached, the insect swarm was wiped out.
Some of the slower-flying ant soldiers were used as pedals by Tang, stepping on them in the air and quickly approaching the king insect battleship.
Dogg and Cynthia below dodged the traps and charged quickly, overturning and knocking down all the human ants along the way.
Tang's eyes were locked on the King Insect Battleship, and he suddenly trembled violently, shouting: "Niko! I'm leaving the messenger to you!"
As he spoke, a gem flew out. It was the homecoming crystal that Tang carried on his body.
"Got it Meow!"
The light flickered, and Neeko appeared in mid-air, with blue light blooming all over her body. Neeko twisted her body in the air and turned into an eagle, passing through the flying ant colony and heading straight for the King Insect battleship.
Upon seeing this, the flying ants rushed towards me with spears, as if they wanted to intercept Neeko. Tang calculated the distance accurately and pointed his sword at the enemy general.
"Duel!"
The storm spread in the air, and both parties disappeared in the air. Neeko successfully passed through the obstacle and boarded the King Insect battleship.
Twisting around, Nicole regained her shape at high altitude, threw out the dagger with silk thread, and quickly beheaded the messenger on the King Insect Battleship.
At this moment, a large number of human ants lost their direction and moved chaotically. Doge seized the opportunity and slashed with a strong thunder attached to his sword, creating a thunder avenue.
The space opened again, the insects scattered the fragments, and Tang, who won the duel, slid down in a parabola.
"Don!" Cynthia shouted, throwing the shield at Tang's feet, turning around and slashing quickly, killing the nearby human ants.
Tang firmly stepped on the shield, used the force to kick off, and flew towards the King Insect Battleship.
Metal Devourer Jinx once again transformed into a giant sword, and swung out the sword with the fire of the red flame lion's teeth and the power of the heart flame that Tang Yu had not used before.
"Breaking through the ice and slashing!"
The magic power expanded rapidly during the slashing, becoming even larger than the King Insect Battleship.
